featureDescriptionModal.detachedArchiveBlockDescription: Detached archives encrypt files and folders using master keys embedded in blocks and are restored using blocks, passphrases and optional YubiKeys.
featureDescriptionModal.detachedArchiveBlocksetDescription: Detached archives encrypt files and folders using master keys embedded in blocksets and are restored using a threshold of blocks and passphrases.
featureDescriptionModal.standaloneArchiveDescription: Standalone archives encrypt files and folders using passphrases and optional YubiKeys and are restored without blocks.
